era_setting.place: Isola del Giglio and the Tyrrhenian Sea off the Italian coast; Civitavecchia, Savona and the western Mediterranean
era_setting.notes: The night is 13 January 2012. The film reaches forward to the Italian investigative body's report of May 2013. A 2012 cruise ship: flat-panel bridge displays, 2012 mobile phones, 2012 clothing. Nothing from the 2020s may appear as present day. This is ITALY and the western Mediterranean -- Italian coastal architecture, Mediterranean light, an Italian island. American or northern-European settings are wrong.

forbidden_claims: Anything about the master's charge, trial, sentence or conviction. The Italian court record is source S3 in the facts ledger and it has NOT been opened. Until it is, no criminal outcome may appear on screen in any form.

That the master abandoned the ship, fled, or was a coward. The record states he left the bridge at about 23:20, was reported not on the ship at 00:34, and was urged by the rescue centre to return (FACTS_LEDGER rows CC-024, CC-026, CC-027). Report those and stop.

That the crew were incompetent, panicked or ran. The report records the opposite from the passengers themselves: crew supported them with humanity and effective action and ferried them off the ship (FACTS_LEDGER row CC-107).

That the ship was unsafe, badly built, or a disaster waiting to happen. The investigative body records that no ship of this kind can be made unsinkable once more than two contiguous watertight compartments flood (FACTS_LEDGER row CC-109). That is a design standard, not a defect.
That the passengers could not have been saved. The body's own modelling says every one of them could have reached safety before the ship reached 30 degrees of heel (FACTS_LEDGER row CC-204).
That anyone knew the rocks were there and went anyway. The report establishes the ship was 0.5 miles south-west of its planned route (FACTS_LEDGER row CC-011). It establishes no intent.
Any figure for people on board other than 4,229 total, 3,206 passengers, 1,023 crew. The ship itself reported at least three different numbers that night (FACTS_LEDGER rows CC-002, CC-020).

That 'the human element is the root cause' means one man. The same report finds a bridge team that warned nobody, a general emergency alarm never effectively given, a 69-minute delay, and 1,936 passengers who had never attended a muster (FACTS_LEDGER rows CC-101, CC-102, CC-103, CC-004).
Anything about the salvage, the righting operation, the tow, or the scrapping. Out of scope of the source and of this film.
That a safety investigation assigns blame. It exists to prevent the next casualty and says so about itself. Every finding taken from it is a finding about a system.
That the weather or the sea contributed. Conditions were favourable (FACTS_LEDGER row CC-003).

That the passengers who had not attended a muster were negligent. They boarded at later ports and were given safety instructions by video, which is what the operation provided (FACTS_LEDGER rows CC-004, CC-005).

beats.headline: HALF A MILE INSIDE THE LINE
NOT PRECEDED BY AN EFFECTIVE ALARM

notes: EP80 of the EP77-82 slate. Runtime and word bands follow the owner's 2026-08-23 decision: 29-32 minutes, divided at the measured 160 wpm, never 176. Source is the Italian Marine Casualties Investigative Body's English report, 181 pages, downloaded and read, with page numbers in the facts ledger; the 61-page MSC90 slide deck that most searches return first is superseded and must not be used. The controlling idea, never spoken: the ship stayed up long enough, nothing else did. Motif: the angle of a floor -- level, thirteen degrees, thirty, forty, eighty, level again. forbidden_subjects bans the casualty itself entirely: no heeled or capsized ship, no rocks, no wreck, no salvage, no person in the water. The film is carried by the bridge, the muster station, the lifeboat davit and the clock. R3 is heavy: the master is alive and was convicted, and the court record is not open, so no criminal outcome may appear until it is. AE beats are declared under decisions/0011 (AE from EP77); the 2026-08-23 message to the production thread deprioritises NEW craft investment but does not repeal that decision -- carry this note into the assembly handover so the two are not read as contradicting.
